questionsMCQ.questionText: What is the time complexity of searching in a balanced Binary Search Tree (BST)?
Which data structure operates on a Last In First Out (LIFO) basis?
Which of the following sorting algorithms has a worst-case time complexity of O(n^2)?
What is the size of an integer variable (int) in standard Java?
In JavaScript, what is the type of a variable that has not been assigned a value?

questionsCoding.title: Even or Odd Sum
questionsCoding.story: The tech wizard of Codeville needs a program that reads a list of space-separated integers from standard input, calculates their sum, and outputs 'EVEN' if the sum is even, or 'ODD' if the sum is odd.
questionsCoding.constraints: The input contains a single line of space-separated integers. Each integer is between -1000 and 1000.

questionsCoding.title: The Cipher's Reverse
questionsCoding.story: For encrypted transmissions, you need to reverse each individual word in a sentence while maintaining the original order of the words. Words are separated by a single space.
questionsCoding.constraints: Input contains words separated by single spaces. Maximum length of sentence is 1000 characters.

questionsCoding.title: Find the Duplicate Signal
questionsCoding.story: You are monitoring sensor data. The signal stream is a list of space-separated integers. There is exactly one number that is duplicated. Find and print the duplicate number.
questionsCoding.constraints: Input consists of N space-separated integers. 2 <= N <= 1000.
